description: The S_4 bridge does not single out the Klein quartic: the Fermat quartic is a second genus-3 curve admitting S_4. Bean qou-8pl1.

klein_quartic.note: S_4 is the point stabilizer of the action on the 7 Fano points

data.verdict: S_4 embeds in the automorphism group of BOTH genus-3 curves, so the S_4 bridge cannot select the Klein quartic.
data.scope: scope-(a). Refutes the S_4 bridge AS AN ARGUMENT for the Bring->Klein degeneration. Does NOT refute the degeneration itself, which remains open and requires a separating invariant.
